message:
`a11y-no-noninteractive-element-interactions` is no longer valid — please use `a11y_no_noninteractive_element_interactions` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/legacy_code

`a11y-click-events-have-key-events` is no longer valid — please use `a11y_click_events_have_key_events` instead
https://svelte.dev/e/legacy_code

Visible, non-interactive element `<code>` with a click event must be accompanied by a keyboard event handler. Consider whether an interactive element such as `<button type="button">` or `<a>` might be more appropriate
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_click_events_have_key_events

Non-interactive element `<code>` should not be assigned mouse or keyboard event listeners
https://svelte.dev/e/a11y_no_noninteractive_element_interactions

`copying` is updated, but is not declared with `$state(...)`. Changing its value will not correctly trigger updates
https://svelte.dev/e/non_reactive_update
